cards.name: Throwing Knife
cards.ability: Atk 3, or Atk 1 and Keep this item

cards.name: Shield
cards.ability: Gain 4 Block.

cards.name: Sai
cards.ability: Starts at 2 each fight. Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used.
cards.notes: This should NOT start at 2 each fight, it should carry over its value between combats (not between dungeons eg adventure mode)

cards.name: Medallion
cards.ability: Block equal to the HP you are missing.

cards.name: Helmet
cards.ability: Block equal to whoever has less HP — you or the enemy.
cards.explainer: (the lower of YOUR HP and ENEMY HP)
cards.flow: Lower HP wins; player value if tied. Recheck on HP change either side.

cards.name: The Boot
cards.ability: Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Combat ends immediately.
cards.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.

cards.name: Bloody Gauntlets
cards.ability: +1 ATK for each HP you are missing.

cards.name: Bracers
cards.ability: Block equal to the weaker Neighboring enemy's Attack.
cards.notes: Final enemy: unusable.

cards.name: Knucklers
cards.ability: Attack equal to 8 minus the Items still in your hand.
cards.flow: Also describes HP Delta (absolute difference of player vs enemy HP).

cards.name: Spiked Flail
cards.ability: Gets stronger. +2 Attack each time you lose any HP.
cards.notes: Change to Base 0 ATK

cards.name: Sledgehammer
cards.ability: Defeat an enemy with 5 or more Attack. Combat ends immediately.
cards.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.

cards.name: Grimoire
cards.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the last monster you faced.
cards.flow: On Spin, store enemy ATK. Initial value is always 0.

cards.name: Breastplate
cards.ability: Gain 2 Block. If you lose HP this combat, Keep this Item.
cards.flow: Tap on use. Discard on resolve unless HP dropped vs On Spin. Healing Potion this combat makes Did Lose HP always True.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.ability: Spin again and gain a Random Item.
cards.flow: End combat without resolving. Spin again, not the same slice. Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic.

cards.name: Fangs
cards.ability: Take their hit (Block still works), Defeat them, then Heal equal to the HP they had.
cards.explainer: (TAKE THEIR ATK) then Defeat then Heal THEIR HP
cards.flow: Store enemy HP on use. Fangs DMG can be blocked like Resolve Combat. Then heal stored HP. Player HP never exceeds 6. If this would kill you: Healing Potion, then Fangs Healing.

cards.name: Poison Flask
cards.ability: Mark a Neighbor. When you spin them, they lose 5 HP immediately.
cards.flow: Lose HP is not ATK dmg (can kill Goblin). Unusable with 0 neighbors. Crossbow-marked neighbors are not choosable.

cards.name: Healing Potion
cards.ability: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3.
cards.flow: If player HP ever equals 0, immediately Discard this item and set the player's HP to 4.

cards.name: Crossbow
cards.ability: Deal 4 Attack to a Neighboring enemy with 4 HP or less.
cards.flow: On use, choose a neighboring enemy with 4 or less HP. Deal 4 attack damage to them. If their HP reaches 0, they are defeated immediately. Goblin cannot receive ATK damage. Unusable with 0 eligible neighbors.

cards.name: Pocketwatch
cards.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the strongest Neighboring enemy.
cards.notes: Final enemy: unusable.

cards.name: Double Axe
cards.ability: Deal 2 Attack to the Owner you are facing and each Neighboring Owner. The same Owner is only hit once.
cards.flow: On use, deal 2 ATK to the facing owner and each unique living neighbor. Two owners left: the other takes 2 once. Goblin ignores ATK. Used up.

cards.name: Victory Flask
cards.ability: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated
cards.flow: On use in a fight, heal 1 + mobs_defeated, cap at 6 HP. Used up. Healing Potion still revives on death.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.ability: Swap a Neighboring Owner into this fight. Draw a Random Item.
cards.flow: On use, pick a living neighbor. Swap that owner with the facing owner. Keep current block, items-used, and snapshots. Draw one item from the remaining pool if any. Used up.

cards.name: Spiked Shield
cards.ability: Deal 2 Attack, or gain 2 Block.
cards.flow: On use, choose ATK 2 or BLK 2. Used up either way.
cards.notes: Art is a stand-in until a spiked shield tile exists.

cards.name: Grief Jar
cards.ability: Each time you Spin, Lose 1 HP and this item gains +2 Block
cards.explainer: On Spin: Lose 1 HP, this Gains 2 Block
cards.flow: While in hand and not spent: at combat start, player loses 1 HP (counts as a bleed for Spiked Flail) and this card's block number +2. On use, gain that much block, then used up. Starts at 0.

cards.name: Longbow
cards.ability: Deal 4 Attack to the monster across from you (only works if even # of monsters remaining)
cards.flow: Usable in a fight only when living slice count is even. Deal 4 ATK to the opposite slice. Goblin ignores ATK. Odd count: cannot use. Used up.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.review_note: (Tier 3) - Heal 2, then Keep this if you are still missing HP.
cards.ability: Heal 2. Keep this if you are still missing HP.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Heal 2, cap 6. If HP is still below 6, keep the card. If you are already at 6, heal 0 and the card is used up. Counts as an item use.
cards.notes: Breastplate keeps if you bled. This keeps if you are still hurt after the heal.

cards.name: Mirror Shard
cards.review_note: (Tier 2) Gains block equal to the last Block you've gained. Tier 2
cards.ability: Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained this dungeon. If you have not gained Block yet this dungeon, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up. Counts as an item use.
cards.notes: Last Block is the amount from the last time you gained Block, not your current Block total.

cards.name: Echo Bell
cards.review_note: (Tier 3) Becomes a copy of the last item you used. (updates on item use, but keeps the echo bell icon faintly in the top right of the card).
cards.ability: Becomes a copy of the last item you used.
cards.flow: In hand this looks like the last item you used this dungeon (faint Echo icon). Click it to use that copy, then Echo is used up even if the original had Keep. If you have not used an item this dungeon, it is Unplayable.
cards.notes: Updates when you use an item. Cube feed is not an item use. First fight of a run: Unplayable.

cards.name: Quiet Bell
cards.review_note:
(Tier 2) Remove the unique ability of the enemy.

(The enemy UI literally removes the text of their ability, and will pretend that it is an abiity-free unit (eg Golem) with the base stats of the unit. This means units with formula stats like Bandit simply turn into their base stats and are badly nerfed by this)
cards.ability: Remove the facing owner's unique ability.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. That owner id loses its unique ability and formulas for the rest of this dungeon. They show printed ATK/HP like Golem. If they have no unique ability, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up otherwise.
cards.notes: Golem: cannot click. Bandit and other formulas fall back to the ATK/HP columns.

cards.name: Net
cards.review_note: (Tier 1) Reduce enemy Atk by 1, 2, or 3.
cards.ability: Reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3.
cards.flow: Click during a fight, then click 1, 2, or 3. Facing Attack drops by that much after every other formula including Commander, floors at 0, then locks for the rest of this fight. Used up.
cards.notes: Caltrops is retired. This is the milder version, last in calc.

cards.name: Chain
cards.review_note: Attack equal to your Block, then Keep this item.
cards.ability: Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. Keep this item.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. You keep that Block. This item Keeps. Unplayable at 0 Block. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
cards.notes: Hornet and Queen still Attack after. You still hold the Block for those swings.

cards.name: Counting Beads
cards.review_note: Alternates from 1, 2, 3, and 4 Atk damage on Item use.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to the dungeon cycle number (1, then 2, then 3, then 4, then 1). Every item use this dungeon advances that number, including this click. The cycle carries across fights and resets on the next dungeon. Two Beads share one number. Used up. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
cards.notes: Cube feed is not an item use, so the cycle does not advance. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack.

cards.name: Paci Fist
cards.review_note:
(Change name to 'Paci-Fist', and icon to an open palm strike)
If you have zero items that deal Atk damage, Defeat the enemy.
cards.ability: If you have zero items that deal Attack, Defeat them.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. If you hold no items that deal Attack, Defeat them. This card is not an Attack item. Unplayable if any other card in hand deals Attack. Used up when it works. Counts as an item use. Gargoyle cannot be Defeated.
cards.notes: Holding only this works. Echo copying an Attack item counts as an Attack item. Shield alone is enough.

cards.name: Scythe
cards.review_note: Attack equal to half your HP (rounded down) and Heal that much. If the enemy survives, Keep this item.
cards.ability: Deal Attack equal to double your HP. If they survive, Heal 2 and Keep this item.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to twice your current HP. If they still have HP after that, including Goblin, Heal 2 and Keep this item. If they die, this is used up and you do not Heal. Counts as an item use.
cards.notes: Goblin takes 0 Attack and still has HP, so Heal 2 and Keep. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack. Ogre HP is your HP, so this can still cut them.

cards.name: Chaos Stone
cards.review_note:
(Change to 'Chaos Stone')

Choose 2 Items and replace them with random Items of the same Tier.

(This should have a similar transformation animation to how Adventure Mode dungeon starters are 'upgraded' in Tier.
cards.ability: Choose other items in your hand. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier.
cards.flow: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item, reroll that one. If you hold two or more, pick two. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier, with the same motion as Adventure Mode starter upgrades. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if this is the only item in your hand. Used up. Counts as an item use.
cards.notes: Does not deal Attack. Gargoyle petrify does not pick this. Cube feed is not this.

cards.name: Cursed Scroll
cards.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP. On use, Heal your HP to up to full (6).
cards.flow: While in inventory unused, Lose 1 HP On Spin after combat has begun. Counts as Did Lose HP for Breastplate.

cards.name: Caltrops
cards.ability: The facing owner's Attack becomes 0 this fight.
cards.flow: Click during a fight. Set facing Attack to 0 and lock it for the rest of this fight, including after Commander and Harpy formulas. They still leave after Done. Used up.
cards.notes: Dragon pierce of 0 is 0. Kobold still swings twice for 0.

cards.name: Dagger
cards.ability: (ATK 2), then return to your hand.
cards.flow: Do not discard on use; Tap. Untap always occurs On Resolve Combat.

cards.name: Helmet
cards.ability: (BLK X), where X is the lowest HP between you and the enemy.
cards.flow: Older check: only enemy HP change, not player HP. Hidden/retired.

cards.name: Bandana
cards.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP.

cards.name: Wizard
cards.ability: My spellbook was in that pile.

cards.name: Golem
cards.ability: My stone fists want that back.

cards.name: Goblin
cards.ability: I cannot take Attack damage.
cards.flow: This unit's HP can never be reduced. Note that this unit can be defeated through all other means.

cards.name: Skeleton
cards.ability: I copy the HP of the last enemy you faced.
cards.flow: On Spin, immediately store the enemy's HP in this value. Overwrite each On Spin.
cards.notes: If this is the first unit faced, set HP to 3.

cards.name: Hornet Swarm
cards.ability: I Attack twice.
cards.flow: On Resolve Combat, takes its current ATK and deals dmg to the player two times. There should be no special or unique interaction with BLK, this should attack in a logically consistent way to if two enemies simply attacked the player, one after the other. For example, the player may actually BLEED twice if both attacks cause the player to lose health.

cards.name: Lich
cards.ability: I give my Neighbors +1 HP.
cards.flow: Set each neighbor's HP to its (Max HP + 1).

cards.name: Ogre
cards.ability: My HP is your HP.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.ability: I gain one HP and Attack with each monster you Defeat.
cards.flow: Every time a slice is removed after the initial drafting phase, this increments.

cards.name: Dire Wolf
cards.ability: My Attack is your HP.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.ability: My Attack is how many Items you hold.

cards.name: Two-Headed Serpent
cards.ability: My Attack drops to 0 if you use two Items this fight.
cards.flow: When player taps 2 items this combat, ATK immediately drops to 0.
cards.notes: If the second item is Smoke Bomb, nothing special. Smoke Bomb happens; when Serpent is spun again later it attacks again.

cards.name: Slime Boss
cards.ability: My Attack always equals my HP.
cards.notes: Only unit whose ATK can change mid-combat. Damaging it affects Sai, Fangs, Sledgehammer.

cards.name: Leech League
cards.ability: My HP equals the number of monsters in play

cards.name: Wraith
cards.ability: I copy the higher ATK of my Neighbors
cards.flow: Resolve order: the only function whose order of operations matters. Match higher neighbor ATK (with their complete modifiers), then receive the ATK increase from Captain.

cards.name: Mimic
cards.ability: If I go down before I Attack, you gain an Item.
cards.flow: Did It Attack? starts False. Set True if the enemy ever attacks. Prevent by killing or defeating with items (not blocking). Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic. If pool empty, draw nothing.

cards.name: Spider Queen
cards.ability: I Attack twice if a Neighbor has less HP than I do.
cards.explainer: double hit if a Neighbor is weaker
cards.flow: Each On Enemy HP Change, if any neighbor has less HP, set times_attack to 2.

cards.name: Commander
cards.ability: I give my Neighbors +2 Attack.
cards.flow: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.

cards.name: Dragon
cards.ability: My Attack ignores Block.

cards.name: Needleback
cards.ability: I Attack you for 1 each time I take ATK damage.
cards.flow: ATK 3, HP 5. Each time this owner receives ATK damage (including a killing blow), the player takes 1 ATK; block applies. Defeat and poison do not poke. Goblin-style immunity does not apply to this owner.
cards.notes: Portrait is a 0x72 wogol stand-in until a porcupine/toad tile exists.

cards.name: Gelatinous Cube
cards.review_note: At the start of combat, selects 2 random items and forces the user to 'feed' them one, discarding it with no effect. (Maybe with a fun dialogue pop-up as it mocks the player and thanks the player for feeding them)
cards.ability: I make you feed me one of two items.
cards.flow: On spin, if you have 0 items, nothing. If 1, you must feed that one. If 2 or more, two random items are offered and you must feed one. The discard is not an item use. ATK/HP unchanged.
cards.notes: Not an item use: no Kobold extra, no Echo update, no Harpy after the feed.

cards.name: Gargoyle
cards.review_note:
(Tier 2) At the start of combat, 'Petrifies' your Item with the highest ATK value

(Waits until after on-spin calculations are finished, then creates a 'stone petrification' texture/overlay on the item with the highest current ATK, making it Unplayable until the fight is over. A tooltip popup should appear when the user holds shift and is reading this ability to define 'Petrify' and explain this mechanic with, "Petrify - becomes Unplayable until your next Spin".

When calculating Atk to choose a target, formula count. If there's a tie, choose at random. If there are no items that deal atk damage, this ability does nothing. Any item that has Atk counts, including things like Longbow and Spiked SHield (but not things like Da Boot and Poison Flask)
cards.ability: I petrify your highest Attack item until you Spin again.
cards.flow: After spin numbers, the highest Attack item in hand becomes Unplayable until the next Spin. Tie is random. No Attack items: nothing. Longbow and Spiked Shield count. Boot and Poison Flask do not. Smoke is a new Spin, so it clears. Attack still works. Cannot be Defeated unless Quiet Bell has silenced me.
cards.notes: Petrify tooltip: Unplayable until your next Spin.

cards.name: Harpy
cards.review_note: At the start of combat, and after the player uses any item, if the Harpy is not already defeated, it will immediately resolve combat by attacking the player. Only after the player clicks 'Done (Take X)' or Defeats/Slays the Harpy will this ability cease
cards.ability: I attack you when we meet, and after each item you use.
cards.flow: On spin, one swing of my current Attack (Block works). After each item fully resolves, if I am still alive, one more swing. Ceases when you click Done or I am Defeated/Slain. Done still takes the normal hit. Not Attack = Block.
cards.notes: One swing, fight stays open. If an item already killed me, no extra swing.

cards.name: Kobold Trapper
cards.review_note: (Tier 2) Attacks an additional time for each item you use during this fight.
cards.ability: I attack an extra time for each item you use this fight.
cards.flow: On Done, swing count is 1 plus items used this fight. Cube feed does not count. Block is spent per swing.
cards.notes: 0 items = 1 swing. 2 items = 3 swings.

cards.name: Clockwork Knight
cards.review_note: (If the player does not Defeat or Slay this monster, it will remove itself from the dungeon and replace itself with 2 Tier 2 Monsters chosen randomly)
cards.ability: If I live, I leave two Tier 2 owners in my place.
cards.flow: If you do not Defeat or Slay me, I leave and two random Tier 2 owners sit immediately, even if that grows the wheel past 8. You are not in a new fight yet. Attack still uses owners left while I am on the wheel.
cards.notes: Quiet Bell strips this: I leave like anyone else, no heirs.

cards.name: Basilisk
cards.review_note:
Slight rewording, but same ability,

"While facing me, all Items are discarded upon use immediately."
cards.ability: I discard every item you use immediately while you face me.
cards.flow: While you fight me, Keep does not work. Every item you use is discarded immediately. Knife nick, Lantern, and Breastplate leave your hand. Quiet Bell strips this.
cards.notes: Keep after the fight is already over does not apply — the toss happens when you click.

cards.name: Twins
cards.review_note:
Change to 'Twins' and replace art with two twin or dopples)

Attack or Block values that are Even happen twice against me.

(Eg if the player uses a weapon that has 2 Attack, it 'attacks twice' and deals 4 total damage against this unit. Similarly, if the player blocks for 4, it will add 4 Block twice for 8 total block.
cards.ability: Even Attack and even Block happen twice against me.
cards.flow: While you fight me, an even Attack number hits me twice as two separate Attacks of that number. An even Block you gain while facing me is gained twice. Odd numbers happen once. Quiet Bell strips this.
cards.notes: Anvil would take 1 from each of those two Attacks. Poison Flask is not an Attack.

cards.name: Beggar
cards.review_note: Replaces its Attack to always equal to the current Attack value of the player's leftmost item (that has an Attack value). Updates this value upon Spin and Item use. If the player has zero such items, then its Attack returns to its base value of 3.
cards.ability: My Attack copies the Attack number on your leftmost Attack item. If you have none, my Attack is 3.
cards.flow: My Attack is the live Attack number on your leftmost item that has an Attack number, after the usual hand sort, skipping cards with no Attack number. It updates on Spin and when you use an item. If you have no such item, my Attack is 3. Quiet Bell: printed Attack.
cards.notes: Spent cards are skipped. Petrified cards have no Attack number for this.

cards.name: Wick
cards.review_note:
Gains +1 Atk and loses 1 HP each time the player uses an item.

Health up0dates immediately upon Item use (regardless of who the player is actively facing), but if the unit drops to 0 HP they will not be Slain until after the current combat is Done
cards.ability: I gain 1 Attack and lose 1 HP whenever you use an item.
cards.flow: Whenever you use an item, every Wick on the wheel gains 1 Attack and loses 1 HP immediately, even if you are not facing them. A Wick at 0 HP is not removed until the fight you are in ends. If you are facing a Wick at 0 HP, they do not Attack; Done removes them as Slain. Cube feed is not an item use. Quiet Bell strips this.
cards.notes: Kobold adds extra swings. I add to the Attack number. Both can stack if they ever sat together; they will not in one fight.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.review_note:
I cannot lose more than 1 HP at a time (from any source).

(Can still be 'defeated', but effects like Poison Flask, Attack Damage, etc. can only reduce its HP by 1 at a time. Notably, things that trigger attacks multiple times would proc this ability twice, making the unit lose 2 total HP for example)
cards.ability: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source.
cards.flow: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source. Attack, Poison Flask, and other HP loss each chip 1. Defeat still works. Two separate Attacks chip 1 twice. Quiet Bell strips this, so full Attack lands.
cards.notes: Needleback poke is not an Item hitting me. Poison Flask is not an Attack. Extra Attacks each chip 1.

taunt.grimoire.4.text: Don't crease it. I'll still fold you.
taunt.grimoire.4.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 4 of 5

taunt.grimoire.5.text: That grimoire called me. You just grabbed.
taunt.grimoire.5.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 5 of 5

taunt.healing_potion.1.text: My juice? Planning to live with MY juice?
taunt.healing_potion.1.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 1 of 5

taunt.healing_potion.2.text: Second chance stolen. I'm reclaiming it full.
taunt.healing_potion.2.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 2 of 5

taunt.healing_potion.3.text: Red flask. Red ending. Brand consistent.
taunt.healing_potion.3.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 3 of 5

taunt.healing_potion.4.text: Don't sip. I want it sealed.
taunt.healing_potion.4.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 4 of 5

taunt.healing_potion.5.text: Sweet steal. I'll take it off the quiet body.
taunt.healing_potion.5.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 5 of 5

taunt.helmet.1.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 1 of 5

taunt.helmet.2.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 2 of 5

taunt.helmet.3.text: You swiped my lid. Bold. Dumb.
taunt.helmet.3.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 3 of 5

taunt.helmet.4.text: That metal's mine. Your thoughts can stay.
taunt.helmet.4.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 4 of 5

taunt.helmet.5.text: Wear it. I'll take the rest separately.
taunt.helmet.5.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 5 of 5

taunt.knucklers.1.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 1 of 5

taunt.knucklers.2.text: You want to punch me with my knuckles. Precious.
taunt.knucklers.2.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 2 of 5

taunt.knucklers.3.text: Those are mine. Your plan is napkin math.
taunt.knucklers.3.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 3 of 5

taunt.knucklers.4.text: Packed for a brawl with stolen gear. Rude.
taunt.knucklers.4.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 4 of 5

taunt.knucklers.5.text: Keep them warm. Reclaiming a pair.
taunt.knucklers.5.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 5 of 5

taunt.medallion.1.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 1 of 5

taunt.medallion.2.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 2 of 5

taunt.medallion.3.text: That medallion hums for me. You're noise.
taunt.medallion.3.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 3 of 5

taunt.medallion.4.text: Hand it over. I'll be almost polite.
taunt.medallion.4.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 4 of 5

taunt.medallion.5.text: Jewelry on a pest. Classic last mistake.
taunt.medallion.5.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 5 of 5

taunt.pocketwatch.1.text: My watch! Time's up — not poetry.
taunt.pocketwatch.1.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 1 of 5

taunt.pocketwatch.2.text: Tick. That's me walking. Tock. That's you not.
taunt.pocketwatch.2.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 2 of 5

taunt.pocketwatch.3.text: Nice steal. Time of death: pending.
taunt.pocketwatch.3.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 3 of 5

taunt.pocketwatch.4.text: You grabbed a clock. I grabbed a seat.
taunt.pocketwatch.4.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 4 of 5

taunt.pocketwatch.5.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 5 of 5

taunt.poison_flask.1.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 1 of 5

taunt.poison_flask.2.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 2 of 5

taunt.poison_flask.3.text: Don't spill. I want every drop home.
taunt.poison_flask.3.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 3 of 5

taunt.poison_flask.4.text: You packed my flask. I packed appetite.
taunt.poison_flask.4.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 4 of 5

taunt.poison_flask.5.text: Keep the symptoms. Return the bottle.
taunt.poison_flask.5.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 5 of 5

taunt.sai.1.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 1 of 5

taunt.sai.2.text: You grabbed my Sai. Now we dance ugly.
taunt.sai.2.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 2 of 5

taunt.sai.3.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 3 of 5

taunt.sai.4.text: Put them down. I asked nice once.
taunt.sai.4.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 4 of 5

taunt.sai.5.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 5 of 5

taunt.shield.1.text: That's MY shield, you little raccoon!
taunt.shield.1.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 1 of 5

taunt.shield.2.text: Hide behind it. I'll wait. I've waited worse.
taunt.shield.2.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 2 of 5

taunt.shield.3.text: Stolen wood won't save sticky fingers.
taunt.shield.3.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 3 of 5

taunt.shield.4.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 4 of 5

taunt.shield.5.text: Keep it up. Makes the pry job easier.
taunt.shield.5.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 5 of 5

taunt.sledgehammer.1.text: MY hammer! Overkill theft. I approve the overkill.
taunt.sledgehammer.1.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 1 of 5

taunt.sledgehammer.2.text: Big tool. Small thief. Short story.
taunt.sledgehammer.2.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 2 of 5

taunt.sledgehammer.3.text: You dragged my sledge into my nest. Fun. Fatal.
taunt.sledgehammer.3.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 3 of 5

taunt.sledgehammer.4.text: Wall can keep the hole. Hammer comes home.
taunt.sledgehammer.4.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 4 of 5

taunt.sledgehammer.5.text: I'll take it. Keep the headache.
taunt.sledgehammer.5.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 5 of 5

taunt.smoke_bomb.1.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 1 of 5

taunt.smoke_bomb.2.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 2 of 5

taunt.smoke_bomb.3.text: You stole my exit. Cute. Cancelled.
taunt.smoke_bomb.3.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 3 of 5

taunt.smoke_bomb.4.text: I live in the dark. Your trick's a candle.
taunt.smoke_bomb.4.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 4 of 5

taunt.smoke_bomb.5.text: Take the bomb. I'll find the smell.
taunt.smoke_bomb.5.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 5 of 5

taunt.spiked_flail.1.text: My flail! Spikes AND theft? Respect. Briefly.
taunt.spiked_flail.1.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 1 of 5

taunt.spiked_flail.2.text: That goes back on my wall. You go on the floor.
taunt.spiked_flail.2.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 2 of 5

taunt.spiked_flail.3.text: Finally a thief with taste. Still a thief.
taunt.spiked_flail.3.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 3 of 5

taunt.spiked_flail.4.text: You picked the mean one. I noticed.
taunt.spiked_flail.4.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 4 of 5

taunt.spiked_flail.5.text: Don't name it. I already did.
taunt.spiked_flail.5.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 5 of 5

taunt.throwing_knife.1.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 1 of 5

taunt.throwing_knife.2.text: You steal a blade and smile? I'm smiling next.
taunt.throwing_knife.2.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 2 of 5

taunt.throwing_knife.3.text: That knife leaves with me. Fingers optional.
taunt.throwing_knife.3.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 3 of 5

taunt.throwing_knife.4.text: One knife. Two claimants. Do the math, pest.
taunt.throwing_knife.4.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 4 of 5

taunt.throwing_knife.5.text: Don't throw it. I want it back unbent.
taunt.throwing_knife.5.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 5 of 5

title.lose_sub.text: Thievery never pays. Or rather, it pays in trouble.

title.rest_sub.text: So you've cleared {n} Dungeons. Better hold on to that loot - you'll need it in the next one.

title.sub.text: You just couldn't keep your grubby hands off their loot, could ya?

title.win_sub.text: Now I just need a place to store this stuff

tutorial.beat.01.body.text: I'm Nib. You're the reason eight angry owners know this address. Survive three scrapes and I'll call you a professional.
tutorial.beat.01.body.where: How to Play step 1 · continue / (none) · main line

tutorial.beat.01.go.where: How to Play step 1 · continue button

tutorial.beat.01.hint.where: How to Play step 1 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.02.body.text: Round room. Eight alcoves. The floor turns — whoever stops in front of you gets a swing. I parked a Golem, a Wizard, and a Berserker. Follow my finger.
tutorial.beat.02.body.where: How to Play step 2 · continue / wheel · main line

tutorial.beat.02.go.where: How to Play step 2 · continue button

tutorial.beat.02.hint.where: How to Play step 2 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.03.body.text: Those hearts are your pulse. Zero means they pry the loot off you. One heart left still counts. Pretty leftovers don't.
tutorial.beat.03.body.where: How to Play step 3 · continue / hearts · main line

tutorial.beat.03.go.where: How to Play step 3 · continue button

tutorial.beat.03.hint.where: How to Play step 3 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.04.body.text: Stolen goods sit along the bottom. Hover a card. Hold Shift if you want the ugly math instead of the big number.
tutorial.beat.04.body.where: How to Play step 4 · hover_item / hotbar · main line

tutorial.beat.04.go.where: How to Play step 4 · continue button

tutorial.beat.04.hint.where: How to Play step 4 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.05.body.text: Helmet's number breathes with your health — ignore it for now. Shield is the soft landing. Flail gets hungrier if you bleed. Boot's the dirty trick. Don't ask how I got it.
tutorial.beat.05.body.where: How to Play step 5 · continue / item:helmet · main line

tutorial.beat.05.go.where: How to Play step 5 · continue button

tutorial.beat.05.hint.where: How to Play step 5 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.06.body.text: Hit Spin. I'll cheat the Golem into place. Big. Slow. Hits for three.
tutorial.beat.06.body.where: How to Play step 6 · spin / spin · main line

tutorial.beat.06.go.where: How to Play step 6 · continue button

tutorial.beat.06.hint.where: How to Play step 6 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.07.body.text: Three coming in. Shield gives four. Tap the Shield before you eat the knuckles.
tutorial.beat.07.body.where: How to Play step 7 · item:shield / item:shield · main line

tutorial.beat.07.go.where: How to Play step 7 · continue button

tutorial.beat.07.hint.where: How to Play step 7 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.08.body.text: Gold in the middle is Block — a pillow for this scrap only. Fight ends, pillow vanishes. Hearts stick around. That's the deal.
tutorial.beat.08.body.where: How to Play step 8 · continue / wheel · main line

tutorial.beat.08.go.where: How to Play step 8 · continue button

tutorial.beat.08.hint.where: How to Play step 8 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.09.body.text: Button says Safe because you covered it. Click it. If a heart had cracked, we'd still walk — breathing is the scoreboard.
tutorial.beat.09.body.where: How to Play step 9 · done / done · main line

tutorial.beat.09.go.where: How to Play step 9 · continue button

tutorial.beat.09.hint.where: How to Play step 9 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.10.body.text: Pillow's gone. You're not. That skull plaque is your tally — Flail's watching it too. Two owners left who want their stuff.
tutorial.beat.10.body.where: How to Play step 10 · continue / trophy · main line

tutorial.beat.10.go.where: How to Play step 10 · continue button

tutorial.beat.10.hint.where: How to Play step 10 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.11.body.text: Spin. Wizard this time. Don't open your mouth for whatever they're cooking.
tutorial.beat.11.body.where: How to Play step 11 · spin / spin · main line

tutorial.beat.11.go.where: How to Play step 11 · continue button

tutorial.beat.11.hint.where: How to Play step 11 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.12.body.text: Five attack, two health. You could pillow up and still get nicked — or end it. Click the Boot. Less health than you? Fight's over. They don't get a speech.
tutorial.beat.12.body.where: How to Play step 12 · item:da_boot / item:da_boot · main line

tutorial.beat.12.go.where: How to Play step 12 · continue button

tutorial.beat.12.hint.where: How to Play step 12 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.13.body.text: That's the other door out of a fight: finish the fragile ones. Flail only fattens when you bleed — you didn't, so it's still a 2. Helmet pillows the last brat.
tutorial.beat.13.body.where: How to Play step 13 · continue / item:helmet · main line

tutorial.beat.13.go.where: How to Play step 13 · continue button

tutorial.beat.13.hint.where: How to Play step 13 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.14.body.text: Last alcove. Hover them. Owners brag if you listen. This one gets louder every time you win. Charming.
tutorial.beat.14.body.where: How to Play step 14 · hover_slice:berserker / wheel · main line

tutorial.beat.14.go.where: How to Play step 14 · continue button

tutorial.beat.14.hint.where: How to Play step 14 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.15.body.text: Spin. Berserker hits three. Helmet matches the smaller health bar — yours or theirs.
tutorial.beat.15.body.where: How to Play step 15 · spin / spin · main line

tutorial.beat.15.go.where: How to Play step 15 · continue button

tutorial.beat.15.hint.where: How to Play step 15 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.16.body.text: Helmet. Now. Four block into three attack. Do the math with your fingers if you have to.
tutorial.beat.16.body.where: How to Play step 16 · item:helmet / item:helmet · main line

tutorial.beat.16.go.where: How to Play step 16 · continue button

tutorial.beat.16.hint.where: How to Play step 16 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.17.body.text: Safe. Pillow dumps. Hearts stay. That's how a thief keeps a pile.
tutorial.beat.17.body.where: How to Play step 17 · done / done · main line

tutorial.beat.17.go.where: How to Play step 17 · continue button

tutorial.beat.17.hint.where: How to Play step 17 · gold hint

tutorial.beat.18.body.text: You're still breathing. I still want my cut. Dive In is the real room — I don't steer, and eight owners show up hungry. Try not to scream for me.
tutorial.beat.18.body.where: How to Play step 18 · continue / (none) · main line

tutorial.beat.18.go.where: How to Play step 18 · continue button

tutorial.beat.18.hint.where: How to Play step 18 · gold hint

warn.boot.text: Can't — they're as healthy as you, or healthier.

warn.crossbow.text: Can't — no soft neighbor who can take a bolt.

warn.sledge.text: Can't — they don't hit hard enough.
